description:
Get full details of a Spark asset by its slug — description, metadata, outcome
reports, bundled files and the URL on spark.entire.vc.

For when a known slug needs inspection before acquisition. Returns Markdown
details, which may include embedded content; get_asset_content obtains the raw
content and a receipt. Public catalog lookup, no login or download recorded.
Missing or unavailable slugs return a not-found message.

For example, get_asset(slug='vb-seo-expert').

slug.description: Exact asset slug from a search result or Spark URL, e.g. 'vb-seo-expert'; not a URL or asset ID.

name: get_asset
title: Get asset details
